verdict.rationale: LiteLLM Proxy ships an official MCP Gateway feature exposing a fixed endpoint for all configured MCP tools, with access controlled by Key/Team, and a UI flow to add MCP servers — this is exactly the 'connect an agent via an official MCP server' capability for a gateway product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that external agents (e.g. Claude, Cursor) successfully connect via this gateway, and deeper documentation of the MCP protocol compliance/auth flow beyond the brief doc mentions.
